setup_steps.title: Inspect and power
setup_steps.action: Prop off. Check labels, soldering, polarity and no +/G short. Meter disconnected ESC lead; insulate any BEC positive. Set Vx=5 V and bridge Vx2.
setup_steps.pass_check: Correct polarity and about 5 V at every low-voltage plug on battery power; no unexpected heating.
setup_steps.if_fail: Disconnect; correct pins/short/jumper. Never parallel ESC BEC with FC 5V or Vx.

setup_steps.title: Firmware and orientation
setup_steps.action: In Mission Planner, load supported stable ArduPlane MatekF405-Wing (V2 needs 4.4+); record version. Read fitted FC arrow/top face; set AHRS_ORIENTATION in Full Parameter List.
setup_steps.pass_check: Displayed attitude follows nose-up/right-roll correctly; USB/SD remain accessible.
setup_steps.if_fail: Fix target or board rotation first; do not compensate with servo reversal.

setup_steps.title: Accelerometer
setup_steps.action: Mission Planner Accel Calibration: disarmed, complete all six positions, holding still at each prompt. Then use Calibrate Level in intended level flying attitude.
setup_steps.pass_check: Calibration accepted; level aircraft displays level.
setup_steps.if_fail: Repeat on firm support; check orientation. Level-only is not full calibration.

setup_steps.title: Compass
setup_steps.action: Mission Planner Compass: calibrate outdoors away from metal/tools, with GPS/compass fixed in final orientation. Reboot if requested.
setup_steps.pass_check: Accepted calibration; smooth heading changes matching known directions.
setup_steps.if_fail: Move magnetic wiring/material; correct orientation and recalibrate.

setup_steps.title: Radio
setup_steps.action: Plain FS-i6X airplane model; transmitter V-tail mix off. Bind iA10B and select servo iBUS/RX2. In Radio Calibration, move all sticks/switches. Assign MANUAL and FBWA in Flight Modes.
setup_steps.pass_check: Inputs match sticks, reach endpoints and centre reliably; modes switch correctly.
setup_steps.if_fail: Fix input map/reversal or iBUS port, before changing surface outputs.

setup_steps.title: Output map and neutral
setup_steps.action: Set SERVO1_FUNCTION=70 (ESC); SERVO3_FUNCTION=4 (left aileron); SERVO4_FUNCTION=4 (right aileron); SERVO5_FUNCTION=79 (left V-tail); SERVO6_FUNCTION=80 (right V-tail). Set SERVO2_FUNCTION and SERVO7_FUNCTION through SERVO10_FUNCTION to 0. Use compatible PWM. Secure centred arms; adjust pushrods before trim.
setup_steps.pass_check: Four surfaces neutral; no steering output; motor stopped at minimum/disarmed.
setup_steps.if_fail: Correct output map/linkage/trim. Shared timer pairs must use compatible protocols.

setup_steps.title: Direction and travel
setup_steps.action: MANUAL: right roll gives right aileron up/left down; pitch-up gives both tail trailing edges up. Right yaw, viewed from behind: left tail trailing edge up/right; right tail down/right. FBWA: tilt right gives left aileron up/right down; nose-up tilt gives both tails down. Test mixed corners.
setup_steps.pass_check: Correct responses; no buzz/binding/horn movement. Initial ceilings: ailerons +/-15 degrees, total mixed V-tail +/-20 degrees, subject to real linkage.
setup_steps.if_fail: Wrong direction: output reversal. V-tail one mixed axis wrong: exchange 79/80; both wrong: reverse output. Reduce MIN/MAX if binding.

setup_steps.title: ESC and motor
setup_steps.action: Identify ESC protocol/manual after RC/output setup. If its PWM manual specifies high/low teaching: prop off, FC on USB, battery disconnected; select MANUAL and arm as required, set throttle high, connect battery, wait specified calibration tone, then lower throttle immediately. Wait confirmation; disconnect and restart at low throttle. DShot/CAN needs no endpoint calibration.
setup_steps.pass_check: Maker acknowledgement; normal reboot gives stopped idle and smooth start. Brief restrained test confirms pusher rotation.
setup_steps.if_fail: Stop on unknown type/tones. Follow actual ESC manual, not Copter motor wizard. Power off before phase swapping.

setup_steps.title: GPS and telemetry
setup_steps.action: Obtain GPS fix outdoors. Connect ground SiK to computer; match baud/protocol. Check radio telemetry without FC USB.
setup_steps.pass_check: Healthy fix, plausible position and continuously updating radio data.
setup_steps.if_fail: Check TX/RX crossing, power, antennas, baud and protocol.

setup_steps.title: Airspeed
setup_steps.action: Set ARSPD_TYPE=1 and ARSPD_BUS=1. Loosely cover pitot against wind at startup; warm at least 1 minute, then use PREFLIGHT CALIBRATE > Do Action to zero. Uncover; apply gentle airflow/pressure.
setup_steps.pass_check: Healthy sensor; near-zero still air, rise with airflow, return afterwards. Small 0-3 m/s noise can be normal.
setup_steps.if_fail: Check supply, I2C, hoses/leaks/kinks; repeat zero without wind. Do not blow hard. This does not calibrate airspeed ratio.

setup_steps.title: Battery and rail load
setup_steps.action: Start BATT_MONITOR=4; BATT_VOLT_PIN=10; BATT_CURR_PIN=11; BATT_VOLT_MULT=11.0; BATT_AMP_PERVLT=66.7. Calibrate against meter/known safe load. Move four servos together under representative load.
setup_steps.pass_check: Voltage/current agree with reference; no reset/dropout; loaded rails remain within device ratings.
setup_steps.if_fail: Fix V2 scales/current-sensor path or resistive joints. Failed capacity needs isolated supply review, not parallel BEC.

setup_steps.title: Failsafes and save
setup_steps.action: Set throttle cut, THR_FAILSAFE=1 and selected RC-loss/low/critical-battery actions. Prop off: switch transmitter off, wait the configured loss timer, then restore it. For a bench battery-trigger check, temporarily set the trigger above measured pack voltage; record action, then restore normal thresholds and reboot. Do not deeply discharge the pack.
setup_steps.pass_check: Ground station detects each loss/trigger, applies chosen action and recovers as planned. Throttle cut stops motor. Save parameters/results.
setup_steps.if_fail: Correct receiver loss reporting or action/timer settings. Held-last throttle fails. Confirm short/long actions separately; ground tests do not prove the airborne RTL path.

unknowns: Actual connector orientation/wire colours; labels and continuity take priority.
FC arrow direction in cross-body placement; do not invent AHRS_ORIENTATION number.
Actual plugs, wire lengths and cooling. Long battery-to-PDB run needs ESC-maker input-lead/capacitor guidance.
Confirm actual sensor/pitot port diagram, not assumed hose colours.
Actual 4S/9045 current, thrust and temperature remain unmeasured.
Site/firmware-specific failsafe actions, battery thresholds and RTL home/route remain to configure.
power_notes: Separate electronics 5V and servo Vx positives; common grounds. Manufacturer budgets:5V 2 A;Vx 5 A continuous/6A peak. Verify actual loaded rails.
Vx -> Vx2 bridge required for internal supply on S5/S6. ESC BEC positive isolated.
Unused 9V/12V/video/LED pads remain empty. Battery balance connector is not FC supply.
N1+FSU1 lift together. Battery unplugs before straps release; slide to Y-205 before lifting. Keep harness clear of Y-280..-120 pack travel.

evidence_note: Published Connections.csv/Equipment.json/Electronics.md and final fuselage_layout read. ArduPilot pages checked live. Matek direct pages redirected; primary search-index content plus established local primary evidence used. No hardware connected.

setup_tool.name: Mission Planner (Windows)
setup_tool.connection: Use a USB data cable to the FC, choose its COM port and Connect. Disconnect the Mission Planner link before Install Firmware; reconnect afterwards.
setup_tool.version_note: Screens vary by Mission Planner release: SETUP may be INITIAL SETUP; CONFIG may be CONFIG/TUNING. Connect to the FC to reveal hardware settings.
setup_tool.first_flash_note: If the new FC has no ArduPilot bootloader, follow the Matek/ArduPilot first-install procedure before Mission Planner firmware updates.

menu_map.path: CONFIG > Full Parameter List; search parameter, edit, Write Params, then reboot if required
SETUP > Mandatory Hardware > Servo Output; Full Parameter List for exact SERVOx_* values
Flight Modes under Mandatory Hardware or CONFIG, depending on release
SETUP > Optional Hardware > Battery Monitor; Full Parameter List for exact BATT_* values
Optional Hardware > Airspeed (SETUP; older docs say CONFIG), or Full Parameter List for ARSPD_*
Choose PREFLIGHT CALIBRATE, then Do Action in the ground-station action controls; location varies
Mandatory Hardware > Failsafe where available; Full Parameter List for exact RC/battery action parameters

mode_meanings.MANUAL: Pilot commands control the surfaces through the configured output mixing, without attitude stabilization.
mode_meanings.FBWA: Flight controller stabilizes roll and pitch; sticks command bank/pitch and the pilot still controls throttle. It is not automatic navigation.
